claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivationPhase.unconditional
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Cure Wounds delivers its effect directly on the touched target with no attack roll and no saving throw. The activation family is the right shape (instant, single-phase, action cost, slot-scaled) but every existing ActivationPhase variant requires a resolution gate (attack_roll or save_gate). An unconditional delivery phase is needed for spells that bypass resolution entirely.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "A creature you touch regains a number of Hit Points equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Effect.heal_hp
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: HealHpEffect already exists in ClassFeatureEffect (Second Wind) but is absent from the spell Effect union used by ActivationPhase branches. Cure Wounds's heal is mechanically identical in shape to Second Wind's heal — DiceAmount with linear_per_level slot scaling — so the same type can be reused or promoted to the shared Effect union.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "A creature you touch regains a number of Hit Points equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. [...] The healing increases by 2d8 for each spell slot level above 1."
